data.title: Crypto's Trump-Fueled Washington Momentum Stalls as Democrats Set to Control Congress
data.description: Crypto's political fortunes in Washington have come to an abrupt halt after Democrats' midterm sweep, with the party set to control Congress, according to Bloomberg. The industry faces the prospect of tougher rules and closer scrutiny of its ties to President Donald Trump.

data.title: Analysts: Five Stock Groups Could Rally After Democrats' Midterm Sweep
data.description:
According to CNBC, Democrats swept the U.S. midterm elections this week, flipping seven Senate seats and more than 40 House seats, and analysts identified five stock groups that could benefit: drone-related, clean-energy, health care, airline and specialty real estate investment trust (REIT) stocks.

William Blair said greater U.S. support for Ukraine could benefit drone makers and battery suppliers. The firm estimated that about 50% of Amprius Technologies' revenue was directly tied to Ukraine or its supporting allies in 2026. Analyst Mark Shooter said increased Ukraine funding could support demand and revenue growth in 2027; he has an outperform rating on the stock.

William Blair upgraded First Solar to outperform from market perform. Analyst Jed Dorsheimer said Democratic gains could increase local support for utility-scale solar procurement and siting. First Solar shares rose 15% over the past week but are down 23% so far in 2026.

Wolfe Research said Democrats' stated agenda to reverse Medicaid cuts and restore expanded Affordable Care Act premium tax credits that expired at the end of 2025 could benefit health care providers, particularly hospitals. HCA Healthcare and Universal Health Services shares have risen 4.6% and 11.1%, respectively, since the beginning of this week.

Citigroup analyst John Godyn said improved consumer sentiment among Democrats could support air travel demand. The U.S. Global Jets ETF has risen about 2% since Election Day, while Delta Air Lines and United Airlines gained 8.8% and 8.2%, respectively, this past week.

Barclays identified Equinix, Iron Mountain and Digital Realty Trust as potential beneficiaries if opposition to data-center development limits new construction and supports pricing power. The three REITs have fallen between 4% and 13% over the past three months.

data.title: Goldman Sachs Recommends Expedia, Hyatt and Other Stocks Beyond Tech
data.description: According to CNBC, Goldman Sachs recommended several stocks beyond technology shares amid continued market uncertainty, including Expedia, Hyatt Hotels, Huntington Ingalls Industries, Chime and Mastercard. The bank raised its price target for Hyatt to $215 per share from $197, and an analyst said the company had growth opportunities into 2027. Huntington Ingalls reported double-digit revenue growth and free cash flow ahead of consensus; its shares are down 15% this year. Mastercard beat earnings expectations, and an analyst said its U.S. business had strengthened; its shares are up 15% this year. Chime reported results modestly ahead of its intra-quarter preannouncement and raised its full-year guidance again. Expedia's third-quarter 2026 report showed core operating metrics exceeded Wall Street expectations and management guidance.

data.title: Serenity Says Year-to-Date Return Is 594.4%, Remains Bullish on Optoelectronics and Storage
data.description: Serenity said in a post on X that his year-to-date investment return remains 594.4%, while noting that Warren Buffett may sleep more soundly than he does. According to Odaily, Serenity said he remains bullish on optoelectronics and storage over the long term, though his investment thesis for those sectors, originally framed around 2027 and 2028, appears to be facing a market test a year early. He added that Buffett manages a much larger portfolio and that Buffett’s roughly 19% return would also be difficult for him to match.

data.title: STOCKS | Berkshire Hathaway Operating Earnings Drop 5.8% as Buybacks Rise
data.description: Berkshire Hathaway Inc. said Saturday that operating earnings fell to $12.7 billion in the third quarter, down 5.8% from a year earlier, according to Bloomberg. Buybacks also rose.

data.title: AI TRENDS | Multiple OpenAI User Accounts Deactivated, Some Pro Subscribers Report No Prior Notice
data.description:
Multiple ChatGPT and OpenAI users reported today that their accounts had been deactivated, with a login message saying they did not have an account because it had been deleted or deactivated. According to Odaily, affected accounts reportedly include free API accounts, shared team accounts and Pro subscriptions costing $200 per month, and some users said they received no advance email notice.

Some users said long-standing paid accounts were deactivated without warning, leaving them unable to access saved conversations and personal memories. There is not enough information to confirm a large-scale account suspension effort by OpenAI, and the reasons for the deactivations and their scope remain unclear.

data.title: AI | Dan Ives Says Election Could Slow AI Buildout as Tech Sells Off
data.description: A sharp post-election technology selloff has investors weighing political resistance to data centers, AI spending and the outlook for Anthropic's IPO, according to Bloomberg. On Bloomberg This Weekend, Yorkville Ives & Co. partner Dan Ives and Bloomberg US equities reporter Natalia Kniazhevich told hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini that the election could slow the AI buildout and reshape winners and losers across tech. Ives said the long-term AI investment cycle remains intact.

data.title: METR Says Anthropic Models Are Improving Twice as Fast as a Year Ago
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher citing The Verge, AI safety research organization METR said after an 11-week study of Anthropic that the company’s models are improving about twice as fast as they were a year ago. METR said progress over the past year was equivalent to roughly two years of earlier advances. As of October, AI was responsible for most of the acceleration in research and development, and its contribution was growing.

The acceleration mainly comes from AI assisting human researchers, rather than working autonomously. In an informal survey, Anthropic employees using the company’s most capable internal models self-reported average productivity about 12 times higher than without AI assistance.

Anthropic heavily redacted its public report. Co-founder Sam McCandlish said the information involved commercially sensitive material and could help other companies accelerate their research and development.

data.title: Crypto Briefing Study: Bitcoin Fell Within 30 Days of Fed Rate Hikes in All 7 Cases
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher citing Bitcoin News and Crypto Briefing, Bitcoin fell within 30 days of a Federal Reserve rate hike in all seven cases since 2016 when the Fed paused once and then resumed raising rates. The median decline was 2.4%. The report says the current period fits this pattern: the Fed raised rates in September, paused in October, and has recently resumed—or is expected to resume—rate hikes.

The study identified 2018 as the closest historical comparison, when Bitcoin fell 42% between the U.S. midterm elections and the December rate hike. The sample covers only seven instances, with a record of zero gains and seven declines.

data.title: Binance Market Update | Anthropic Targets Up to $1.75T IPO Valuation as December Fed Hike Odds Rise to 78%
data.description: Anthropic still plans to list before Thanksgiving at a $1.25T-$1.75T valuation, raising $80B-$100B despite the tech sell-off. US stocks closed mixed Friday as chips rebounded (Philadelphia Semiconductor Index +4.21%), while October payrolls of 165,000 beat expectations and lifted December hike odds to 78% from 70%. Tuesday’s October CPI is the next test, with consensus at 3.7% headline and 2.5% core. Bitcoin ETFs saw $412M in outflows, $403M from IBIT. China’s central bank extended its gold-buying streak to two years.Anthropic Still Plans Pre-Thanksgiving IPO, Targeting Up to $1.75 Trillion ValuationAnthropic plans to list before US Thanksgiving, targeting $1.25T-$1.75T and proceeds of $80B-$100B, per the Financial Times via ChainCatcher. The midpoint of about $1.5T is below the $2T some investors had expected, as tech stocks sell off. Investors said it hopes to list on schedule even at a lower valuation. Q3 revenue grew nearly 50% to about $17B, and the annualized run rate is about $81B, up from $65B at end-July. It plans about $900B of compute and infrastructure spending over the coming years and holds nearly $150B in cash and liquid investments. JPMorgan is expected to brief potential investors on November 13.Mixed Close as Chip Stocks Rebound, Microsoft Winds Down Oracle AI Computing DealThe Dow fell 0.46% to 51,285.73, the S&P 500 rose 0.31% to 7,376.86 and the Nasdaq gained 1.09% to 24,579.42. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rose 4.21%: AMD over 11%, Intel over 7%, TSMC over 6%. Thursday’s data center slowdown fears had wiped out $1T from the Magnificent Seven in a day. Democratic lawmakers, including Texas governor-elect Gina Hinojosa, called for curbing data center expansion, though they take office in January. Consensus is +0.3% monthly headline, +0.2% core, with annual headline steady at 3.7% and core easing to 2.5% from 2.6%. Survey data points to upside risk: ISM Services Prices Paid at 73, and S&P Global PMIs showed selling prices rising at their fastest pace since August 2022. LSEG data showed a 75% probability of a December 9 hike. Monex’s Nick Rees said that without a significant downside surprise in CPI or the November jobs report on December 4, a hike could be almost fully priced in. Seeking Alpha’s Damir Tokic argued AI bubble concerns could eventually outweigh inflation data and shift the Fed toward easing.Bitcoin ETFs See $412M in Net Outflows, With BlackRock's IBIT Losing $403MSpot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $412M in net outflows on November 6 (US Eastern Time), per PANews citing SoSoValue. IBIT posted the largest outflow at $403M, while Fidelity’s FBTC had the largest inflow at $42.8M.China’s Gold-Buying Streak Reaches Two Years as Prices FallChina’s central bank added to gold reserves in October, extending its buying streak to two years, per Bloomberg. Gold fell almost 7% in the month and ended below the $4,000 support threshold.Two flags: story 4’s source text was cut off mid-sentence, so I used only the figures before the cut. data.title: BNB Chain Says Red Alarm Flags Potentially High-Risk dApps and Contracts
data.description: BNB Chain announced on X that its Red Alarm service flags potentially high-risk decentralized applications (dApps) and contracts, providing users with more information. The chain described user safety as ongoing work across crypto and said Red Alarm contributes to that effort.

data.title: Bitcoin Mining Difficulty Stays Below Record High for 374 Days, Longest Period on Record
data.description:
Bitcoin mining difficulty has remained below its all-time high for 374 consecutive days, setting a record for the longest such period in the network’s history. According to Odaily, the stretch exceeds the 364 days after the 2011 market crash and the 253 days following China’s 2021 mining ban.

Economist Saifedean Ammous said neither the 95% Bitcoin price decline in 2011 nor China’s mining ban in 2021 led to a longer period of low mining difficulty. The metric fell to 124.93T in mid-June 2026, about 20% below its 155.97T peak, recorded on October 29, 2025, before recovering to 148.36T in October. Mempool.space estimates the next difficulty adjustment will occur around November 13 and could bring a decline of about 3.7%.

data.title: Venezuelan Man Arrested Near White House After Claiming He Planned to Assassinate U.S. President Donald Trump
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher citing Fox News, U.S. Department of Homeland Security officials said a Venezuelan national was arrested by Secret Service agents near the White House on Thursday night. Agents approached his vehicle on Constitution Avenue in Washington after noticing suspicious behavior. The man said voices in his head told him to travel to Washington to assassinate the president and admitted there were weapons in the vehicle.

The vehicle had previously been reported stolen. A search found three firearms and dozens of rounds of ammunition, including an AR-15-style rifle and two handguns. The suspect, Ronny Yordrix Guanipa Chrinos, entered the United States through Texas in March 2024 and was previously arrested by Border Patrol before being released into the country during the Biden administration.

U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement requested that the U.S. Marshals Service, which is holding the suspect, detain him. Prosecutors filed charges including carrying a rifle outside a home or business, illegally transporting firearms, possessing unregistered firearms and ammunition, unauthorized use of a motor vehicle, theft, and receiving stolen property. Secret Service Director Sean Curran said personnel used their training to address an imminent threat to their protectee and the public.

data.title: PS5 Pro Sold Out Everywhere as GTA VI Pre-Loads Start Next Week
data.description: GTA VI pre-downloads begin Tuesday, November 10, and require 212 GB of free storage, while the PS5 Pro is sold out at major U.S. retailers. Retailers list the console at its $899 price, while resellers ask $1,399 to more than $1,600, according to BeInCrypto. Sony raised PS5 Pro prices by $200 since April and lifted its net profit forecast for the year ending March 2027 to a record 1.33 trillion yen; its shares rallied 7% this week before giving back part of their gains Friday. GTA VI launches Nov. 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and Take-Two Interactive’s stock slide this year leaves it heavily dependent on the release.

data.title: Fomo Names Clicker Creator Kyle Head of Partnerships
data.description: Fomo has appointed Kyle, creator of social trading network Clicker, as its Head of Partnerships. According to Foresight News, he will focus on public-chain partnerships and team tags, with the aim of increasing activity and helping project teams reach token holders directly. Kyle previously made an angel investment in Fomo, and his public account ranks among the top 20 on the platform’s all-time trading leaderboard.

data.title: Aave Founder Stani Kulechov: Bitcoin Is More Important Than Ever Amid Paraguay Bank Crisis
data.description: Aave founder Stani Kulechov said Bitcoin is more important than ever, pointing to events in Paraguay. According to Foresight News, his remarks came as depositors at Paraguayan digital bank Ueno were unable to withdraw funds after the central bank took control of the bank. Reuters reported that the situation prompted protests calling for the return of funds, faster compensation and accountability. Those affected included retirees who received pension payments through Ueno.

data.title: GEOPOLITICS | Meloni Links Cyberattack on Foreign Minister to Pro-Russian Hackers
data.description: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni blamed pro-Russian hackers for a cyberattack on her foreign minister, following a rise in hybrid disruptions from entities aligned with Vladimir Putin’s government, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: ZachXBT Says Gamblers Still Provide Exit Liquidity for Ansem Despite Criticism of Small-Cap and Celebrity Coin Promotions
data.description: ZachXBT said on X that he had repeatedly criticized Ansem for promoting small-cap tokens and celebrity coins. According to Odaily, ZachXBT said gamblers in the current market cycle have again given Ansem credibility and provided exit liquidity.

data.title: JUST, Monero and LEO Token Defy Crypto Market Crash
data.description: JUST (JST), Monero (XMR) and LEO Token (LEO) have held key technical levels as Bitcoin trades around $76,000 amid a broader market downturn. The three altcoins have shown resilience, according to BeInCrypto: JST has gained roughly 265% since February, XMR is up more than 120% from its February low near $276, and LEO trades roughly 12% below its May all-time high of $10.61. Key support levels are $0.135 for JST, $600 for XMR and $8.91 for LEO; a decisive Bitcoin break below $75,000 could add pressure.

data.title: Iraq's Oil Minister: Daily Crude Oil Production Exceeds 5 Million Barrels
data.description: According to Jin10, Iraq's oil minister said the country's average daily crude oil production exceeds 5 million barrels.
